claims.text: Estrogen-progestin oral contraceptives block the ovulatory surge of sex steroids;
claims.quote: Estrogen-progestin oral contraceptives, which block the ovulatory surge of sex steroids

claims.text: most effective is drospirenone + ethinyl estradiol with a shorter (4-day) hormone-free interval.
claims.quote: most effective is a combination of drospirenone and ethinyl estradiol and a regimen with a shorter hormone-free interval (4 rather than 7 days)

claims.text: Risk of venous thromboembolism may be higher with drospirenone.
claims.quote: risk of venous thromboembolism may be increased with third generation progestins, such as drospirenone

claims.text: Progesterone vaginal suppository 200-400 mg once a day,
claims.quote: Progesterone by vaginal suppository (200 to 400 mg once a day)

claims.text: micronized progesterone 100 mg at bedtime for 10-12 days before menses,
claims.quote: An oral progestogen (eg, micronized progesterone 100 mg at bedtime) for 10 to 12 days before menses

claims.text: or medroxyprogesterone 200 mg IM every 2-3 months.
claims.quote: A long-acting progestin (eg, medroxyprogesterone 200 mg IM every 2 to 3 months)

claims.text: Rarely, for very severe or refractory symptoms: a GnRH agonist (eg, leuprolide 3.75 mg IM or goserelin 3.6 mg SC monthly) with low-dose estrogen/progestin.
claims.quote: Rarely, for very severe or refractory symptoms, a gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) agonist (eg, leuprolide 3.75 mg IM, goserelin 3.6 mg subcutaneously every month) with low-dose estrogen/progestin

claims.text: Fluid retention may be relieved by reducing sodium and taking a diuretic (eg, spironolactone 100 mg orally once a day) just before symptoms are expected.
claims.quote: Fluid retention may be relieved by reducing sodium intake and taking a diuretic (eg, spironolactone 100 mg orally once a day) just before symptoms are expected

claims.text: Calcium 600 mg twice a day may lessen negative mood and somatic symptoms;
claims.quote: Calcium supplements (600 mg twice a day) may lessen negative mood and somatic symptoms

claims.text: chasteberry, vitamin B6 (no more than 100 mg/day) and vitamin E are mildly effective.
claims.quote: Some dietary supplements are mildly efficacious for reducing symptoms; they include chasteberry extract from the agnus castus fruit (which appears to lessen physical symptoms), vitamin B6 (no more than 100 mg a day), and vitamin E
